name: shot_light
description: Light trike-tank cannon: a snappy dry crack with a small thump.

name: shot_middle
description: Middle tank cannon: a crack over a round boom, the barrel ringing low.

name: shot_heavy
description: Heavy tank cannon: a deep chesty blast with a sub drop and a long rumble.

name: shot_defender
description: Defender turret: a clanking mechanical double tap.

name: shot_alien
description: Alien energy weapon: a falling, beating, ring-modulated plasma bolt.

name: impact
description: Shell hitting armour: a hard click, a thud and a clank of plate.

name: explosion_small
description: Unit destroyed: a boom with a falling dusty roar and bits of metal.

name: explosion_big
description: Building destroyed: a deep double blast, debris and a rolling sub rumble.

name: harvest
description: Harvester scooping crystals: a gritty scrape with glassy tinkles.

name: unload
description: Crystals delivered: a glassy cascade, then a low D to A bell for the credits.

name: build_start
description: Construction starts: a clamp clunk and a servo winding up.

name: build_done
description: Building or unit finished: a pneumatic release and a dark D bell chord.

name: unit_ready
description: New tank out of the factory: an engine rev under a short low brass call.

name: select
description: Unit selected: a soft low blip.

name: order
description: Order acknowledged: two quick muted notes rising A to D.

name: error
description: Can't do that: a dull buzzy double bzz on a clashing semitone.

name: click
description: UI button: a tiny dark tick.

name: alert
description: Base under attack: a dark D/Eb alarm over a low pulse.

name: self_destruct
description: Autodestruct armed: a rising saw beeping faster, cut off at the top.

name: victory
description: Victory stinger: taiko and brass climbing Bb, C to an open D major chord.

name: defeat
description: Defeat stinger: brass falling Eb to D minor, a throat voice and a last boom.
